summary: Full E2E testing of PilahIn (community waste-mgmt app). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/register/me, role guard, invalid pin), warga (dashboard, missions list+complete+duplicate-block, schedule+confirm toggle, catalog, redeem+insufficient-poin, history) and petugas (find warga, rates, weigh with 10% clean bonus, today, 403/401 guards). Frontend: logged in as warga via data-testid controls, navigated /beranda /misi /jemput /tukar — streak, member-code (PLH-0503-0127), redeem buttons (6), tukar-saldo (1.332 poin) rendered; mission 'Tandai' worked; 'Saya siap dijemput' toggled; logged out and logged in as petugas, found warga by member code, +/- steppers worked, clean-bonus toggle added 10% (3 kg organik => 15 poin base + 10% rounded = 17 total matches backend math 30*0.1=3 → rounded wait: 1.5kg*10=15, 15*0.10=1.5≈2 → 17 ✓), save & next-warga worked.

issues: Point balance briefly shows em-dash '—' placeholder while GET /api/warga/dashboard loads; no skeleton/spinner. Minor UX polish only.

action_items: Optional: add a loading skeleton on Beranda saldo poin + next pickup instead of em-dash while dashboard fetch resolves.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~537 lines) is close to the 700-line threshold but still manageable; consider splitting into routers (auth/warga/petugas) + seed module as the app grows.
warga_missions streak loop queries mission_completions per day in a Python for-loop — O(60) round-trips; fine for scale now but switch to a single $group aggregation when traffic grows.

`CORS_ORIGINS` default of '*' combined with `allow_credentials=True` is invalid per CORS spec; browsers will reject credentialed requests when origin is '*'. Safe here (JWT is in header, not cookies), but set explicit origins before shipping.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/login — brute-force PIN (6 digits) is feasible. Add attempt lockout.
JWT exp = 7 days with no refresh/rotation — acceptable for MVP, document it.
Petugas endpoints do not scope by RT/RW — any petugas can weigh any warga across the kelurahan. Intentional for MVP but worth gating later.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing seed). Tests created a few throwaway warga accounts via /api/auth/register with phones like 0812XXXXXXXX for the insufficient-poin and register duplicate tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is pytest-based and uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Note it mutates seeded warga 'Bu Ratna' points (missions complete + redeem + weigh). If a test depends on exact 1240 starting points, reset DB first. Backend hot-reloads via supervisor; seed() is idempotent.
